{{Quote|Subject wanted for the murder of several local business owners.|Brakko Gaz's bounty brief|<ref name="BH" />}}
'''Brakko Gaz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|from]]<ref name="Prima" /> the [[planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].<ref name="Prima" /> By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'', including Brakko Gaz's capture on [[Outland Transit Station|Outland Station]], to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Gaz had become affiliated with the [[Death stick/Legends|death stick]] [[Drug dealer|dealer]] [[Groff Haugg]]<ref name="Prima" /> and had [[Death|murdered]] several prominent business owners on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CSWE" /> As a result, the [[Republic Security Force/Legends|Republic Security Force]] placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on<ref name="Prima" /> him<ref name="CSWE" /> for 1,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] alive or 500 dead.<ref name="Prima" /> Eventually, Gaz joined a group of thugs working for the criminal [[Meeko Ghintee]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Outland Transit Station|Outland Station]].<ref name="BH" />

In 32 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Gaz ambushed the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] with two other Rodians and two [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] in<ref name="BH" /> a changing room<ref name="Prima" /> on Outland Station. Fett, who was actively hunting for Ghintee, dispatched Gaz's companions,<ref name="BH" /> captured Gaz alive, and turned him in for the full sum of credits.<ref name="CSWE" /> The Rodian had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin, red head spines, black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and wielded a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]. Gaz wore a red [[shirt]], gray [[Armor/Legends|armor]], tan [[Clothing|pants]], and black shoes.<ref name="BH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Brakko Gaz first appeared in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'', developed by [[LucasArts]]. In the game, Gaz is the third optional bounty available to the player that can be captured alive for a higher sum of credits or killed for a lower amount.<ref name="BH" /> In the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', Brakko Gaz's entry is erroneously titled "Guz, Brakko." The book also confirmed Gaz's capture and delivery by Fett.<ref name="CSWE" />
